verses.text: halal muntaqaa khayril baraayaa muhammadi
salaamayka khallid yaa ilaahii bihummadi
ayaa maahiyan min qabli haksashin maa asaa
lifadlin wa takriimin wa majdin wa suudadi
mazaayaa karaamat haddahaa qabliyal malaa
wa kalluu wa maa zul ijtihaadi kazidadi
hadaa bika rabbii kulla man raama had-yahu
halayka salaatul laahi yaa khayra muhtadi
kitaabuka lii kanzun wa jaahun wa rifhatun
wa man yurdi bil qur-aani mawlaaka yahtadi
salaamal lazii  ahlaaka yaa khayra munzalin
halaa khayri mabhuusin ilal khalqi murshidi
shakartu halaykal laahi shukran yaziidunii
wa man bika yanhush shukra yaa zikru  yurshadi
falaahul lazii yatluuka yabqaa mukhalladan
ilal jannatil hul-yaa bighayrit taraddudi
yaqiinii yaqiinii tarkakad dahra yaa hudan
mahaa bika rabbii duuna raddin takhaddudii
rabbaahul lazii yatluuka rinhu mubashsharin
wa man bika yabghil fawza yaa zikru yas-hadi
bikal laahu ahtaanii amaanan minal azaa
ladaa kulli man yadnuu wa kulli mubahhadi
yaquudu liyal baaqii bikas su-la aaminan
wa man bika yabghin nasra yaa zikru yunjadi
halimtu yaqiinan annakal khayru wal hudaa
wa man yabghi majdan khaalidaa bika yumjadi
aruumu bikal haajaati min khayri munzilin
wa lii bika haajin qad qadaa duura mufsidi
lighayrin tahat dunyaa wa ukhraa madarratun
kafaanii bilaa luq-yaa bikal laahu hussadii
liyal laahu yubdil ghayba mahmaa aradtuhu
bikal yawma yaa qur-aana rabbii wa fii ghadi
izaa rumtu min rabbii bikas su-la niltuhu
bikal laahu saffaa lii baqaa-a bi-arghadi
wa ristuka yaa qur-aana rabbii bifadlihi
faman lam yuwaa fiqnii lighayriya yutradi
widaadii libaaqin anzalaz zikra muhkaman
halaa man bihi lam yanhunii zuu tamarrudi
liwajhika hannii salli rabbii musalliman
halaa khayri khalqil laahi turran muhammadi
